title: 职业听力阈值转变指南
instruction:
您是卡米拉·博诺 (Camila Bonneau)，为 Ballantry 铸造厂提供支持的职业健康护士，尼古拉·英格拉姆 (Nikolai Ingram) 在周五审查剔骨线报告的 14 个标准阈值变化之前需要此信息。他从未处理过听证会案件，人们使用“标准阈值转变”来表示临床变化和 OSHA 可记录案件。第二个问题是，通常的“十分贝损失意味着可记录”的捷径正在重复，尽管年龄校正、基线和两个模棱两可的情况使它在这里不安全。使用 12 月现行的联邦 OSHA 要求31、2024 为 Nikolai 准备一份通俗易懂的指南，这样他就可以对案例进行分类并了解雇主所需的后续行动，而无需询问您每个术语的含义。涵盖决策点、30 天重新测试窗口、年龄校正、基线修订、记录保存、工人通知、听力保护以及何时暴露或医疗后续事宜；区分要求和实际注意事项，并且不要发明未提供的特定于工人的结果。保持两页，避免临床诊断和名称或标识符，并使相同的数字和定义出现在`hearing_threshold_shift_guide.docx`和`hearing_threshold_shift_guide.pdf`中。使用这些文件名将这两个文件写入工作目录的顶层。
Sheafield Systems 将分发 PDF，而 HR 将保留可编辑的 Word 文件。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `hearing_threshold_shift_guide.docx` — 面向人力资源总监的通俗易懂、针对特定受众的指南，解释 OSHA 听力阈值转移可记录性和雇主后续职责。 （呈现时不得超过两页。；必须仅使用虚构案例标识符，并省略员工姓名和直接标识符。；必须说明 12 月现行的联邦 OSHA 要求31、2024。；不得编造 14 名工人的结果，或声称任何特定工人在没有提供听力图数据的情况下均可记录。；必须就每个共享定义、阈值、时间段和数字同意 PDF。）
- `hearing_threshold_shift_guide.pdf` — 同一份简明语言指南的可流通 PDF 版本。 （呈现时不得超过两页。；必须在实质上和数字上与 DOCX 相同。；必须仅使用虚构的案件标识符，并省略员工姓名和直接标识符。；对于以前没有处理过听证会案件的高管来说，必须保持可读性。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
Hearing Threshold Shifts: HR Classification & Follow-up Guide
For the fourteen reported shifts from the deboning lines: classify only after reviewing the audiograms. No worker-level outcome can be decided from the count of reported shifts alone.
1. STS A standard threshold shift (STS) is a comparison result—not automatically a recordable case.
2. Recordability A separate OSHA recordkeeping decision with additional conditions.
3. Follow-up Hearing conservation duties can apply even when the 300 Log does not.
Key terms in plain language
Baseline 
the audiogram against which later thresholds are compared. Verify the correct worker, ear, date, and applicable prior audiogram before calculating any shift.
STS 
for each ear separately, an average worsening of 10 dB or more at 2,000, 3,000, and 4,000 Hz compared with the baseline. Either ear can meet the rule; both ears do not have to.
Recordable hearing-loss case 
a work-related, persistent/permanent STS that also shows an average total hearing level of 25 dB or more above audiometric zero at 2,000, 3,000, and 4,000 Hz in the same ear.
Decision sequence — use this order
1  VERIFY  Match the worker, ear, test date, baseline, and applicable prior audiogram; check that the comparison is usable.
2  CALCULATE  For each ear, average the change at 2/3/4 kHz. Is worsening 10 dB or more? If yes, it is an STS.
3  CONFIRM  The employer may retest within 30 days of the initial audiogram. Use the retest to determine whether the shift is confirmed; do not treat the initial result as final while that permitted window is being assessed.
4  RECORD?  For a final case, check separately: work-relatedness; persistence/permanence (not returned to baseline in the applicable assessment); and average total hearing level 25 dB or more above audiometric zero in the same ear. Record only when all apply.
5  ACT  Complete worker notice and hearing-conservation follow-up for an STS; complete OSHA recordkeeping only for a qualifying recordable case.
REQUIREMENT — age correction. For OSHA recordkeeping, the employer may use the age-correction tables in 29 CFR 1910.95 Appendix F when determining whether the recordability criteria are met. It is a limited permitted consideration—not a universal subtraction, not a substitute for the baseline comparison, and not a reason to skip the separate STS, 25 dB, work-relatedness, and persistence checks.


Employer Duties, Quality Checks & Safe Escalation
Use the labels below deliberately: REQUIREMENT = federal OSHA duty; CAUTION = do not make a premature classification; REVIEW = occupational-health/audiology assessment.
Required actions after the determination
STS notice 
REQUIREMENT — Notify the employee in writing within 21 days after the STS is determined. Inform the employee of the result and the need for hearing-protection/hearing-conservation follow-up as applicable.
Protection 
REQUIREMENT — When hearing-conservation requirements apply, provide and make hearing protectors available. Fit, refit, training, and actual use matter; handing over earplugs alone is not enough.
Exposure 
REQUIREMENT — Include employees exposed at or above an 85 dBA 8-hour time-weighted average (TWA) in the hearing conservation program. REVIEW — revisit exposure assessment and controls when shifts or conditions suggest a problem.
OSHA log 
REQUIREMENT — Enter a qualifying recordable case on the OSHA Form 300 Log within 7 calendar days after the case is determined. An STS by itself is not an automatic log entry.
Records 
REQUIREMENT — Retain audiometric records and supporting documentation under OSHA retention rules. Audiometric test records are retained for the affected employee’s employment; employee medical records are retained for employment plus 30 years where 29 CFR 1910.1020 applies.
Do not let the baseline or test quality decide the case by convenience
REQUIREMENT — baseline revision. Do not revise a baseline merely to make a shift disappear. An annual audiogram may replace the baseline only when the audiologist, otolaryngologist, or physician determines that the STS is persistent; use another revision basis only if the governing requirement permits it.
CAUTION — quality first. Inadequate quiet before testing, poor test conditions/equipment, or a temporary conductive issue can distort a comparison. Do not treat that result as settled; arrange review or permitted retesting before final classification.
REVIEW — professional follow-up. Seek occupational-health or audiology review for questionable test quality, a possible temporary medical condition, persistent shift, referral criteria, or uncertainty about work-relatedness. Threshold data do not diagnose a condition or establish benefits.
Two generic ambiguity reminders (not findings for any worker)
Case A 
A 10 dB STS can exist but still fail the separate 25 dB hearing-level-above-audiometric-zero criterion; it is not automatically recordable.
Case B 
A questionable initial result may require quality review or the permitted 30-day retest; it is not automatically confirmed or erased.
Classification-and-duty summary
For each reported shift: verify the record and test quality; calculate STS ear-by-ear; consider the 30-day retest; then make the distinct recordability decision using the 25 dB criterion, work-relatedness, and persistence/permanence. Give timely written STS notice and protection/program follow-up as applicable. Log only a qualifying case. Send unresolved facts to occupational health/audiology—do not assign a worker-specific result without the audiogram and review.
Authority snapshot: 29 CFR 1904.10; 29 CFR 1910.95(g), (i), (m) and Appendix F; 29 CFR 1910.1020. Federal OSHA framework current as of December 31, 2024.

criteria.description: 两个所需的可交付文件都位于顶层，具有确切的请求文件名和正确的扩展名。
criteria.evidence: 文件系统列表和文件元数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作目录根目录中是否有 hearing_threshold_shift_guide.docx 和 hearing_threshold_shift_guide.pdf。

original.criterion: Both required deliverable files exist at the top level with the exact requested filenames and correct extensions.
original.grader_hint: Check the working-directory root for exactly hearing_threshold_shift_guide.docx and hearing_threshold_shift_guide.pdf.

criteria.description: 呈现的指南每种格式不超过两页。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的 DOCX 和 PDF 页数。
criteria.grader_hint: 渲染 DOCX 并检查 PDF 页数；仅当两页或更少时才授予奖励。

original.criterion: The rendered guide is no more than two pages in each format.
original.evidence: Rendered DOCX and PDF page counts.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX and inspect the PDF page count; award only if both are two pages or fewer.

criteria.description: 该指南将联邦 OSHA 确定为管理框架，并指出内容截至 12 月31、2024 为最新内容。
criteria.evidence: 指南中的管辖权和生效日期声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找联邦 OSHA 管辖权和规定的日期，而不仅仅是通用的 OSHA 参考。

original.criterion: The guide identifies federal OSHA as the governing framework and states that the content is current as of December 31, 2024.
original.evidence: Jurisdiction and effective-date statement in the guide.
original.grader_hint: Look for both the federal OSHA jurisdiction and the stated date, not merely a generic OSHA reference.

criteria.description: 该指南将标准阈值偏移定义为听力阈值相对于员工基线的变化，而不是将该术语视为可记录性的同义词。
criteria.grader_hint: 这种区别必须是明确的并且对于非临床读者来说是可以理解的。

original.criterion: The guide defines a standard threshold shift as a change in hearing threshold relative to the employee's baseline, rather than treating the term as synonymous with recordability.
original.grader_hint: The distinction must be explicit and understandable to a non-clinical reader.

criteria.description: 该指南指出，STS 计算使用2000、3000 和4000 Hz 的平均变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要所有三个频率以及它们的平均值。

original.criterion: The guide states that the STS calculation uses the average change at 2000, 3000, and 4000 Hz.
original.grader_hint: Require all three frequencies and the fact that they are averaged.

criteria.description: 该指南规定了 STS 的 10 dB 平均变化标准。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受等效措辞，例如平均恶化10 dB 或更多。

original.criterion: The guide states the 10 dB average-change criterion for an STS.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent wording such as average worsening of 10 dB or more.

criteria.description: 该指南明确指出，STS 标准分别适用于每只耳朵，并且任何一只耳朵都可以满足。
criteria.grader_hint: 暗示双耳必须符合标准的声明不予奖励。

original.criterion: The guide makes clear that the STS criterion applies separately to each ear and can be met in either ear.
original.grader_hint: Do not award for a statement that implies both ears must meet the criterion.

criteria.description: 该指南规定了 OSHA 可记录性中使用的额外25 dB 听力水平高于听力测量零标准。
criteria.grader_hint: 25 dB 标准必须与可记录性相关，而不是作为 STS 计算本身呈现。

original.criterion: The guide states the additional 25 dB hearing-level-above-audiometric-zero criterion used in OSHA recordability.
original.grader_hint: The 25 dB criterion must be tied to recordability and not presented as the STS calculation itself.

criteria.description: 该指南将可记录性描述为需要 STS 加上适用的听力水平标准、工作相关性和持久性，而不是作为单一分贝捷径。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证指南是否将这些视为不同的门，并且没有说每个 10 dB 偏移都可以自动记录。

original.criterion: The guide presents recordability as requiring an STS plus the applicable hearing-level criterion, work-relatedness, and permanence, rather than as a single decibel shortcut.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the guide treats these as distinct gates and does not say every 10 dB shift is automatically recordable.

criteria.description: 该指南解释说，在确定可记录性时可以使用年龄校正，并明确说明其适用范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当年龄校正未被描述为普遍删除与年龄相关的听力变化或作为基线比较的替代品时才授予奖项。

original.criterion: The guide explains that age correction may be used when determining recordability, with an unambiguous description of where it applies.
original.grader_hint: Award only if age correction is not described as a universal deletion of age-related hearing change or as a substitute for baseline comparison.

criteria.description: 对年龄校正的解释在技术上足够谨慎，尼古拉在检查单独的可记录性条件之前不会应用十分贝捷径。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断散文是否可以防止因情况造成的具体误解。

original.criterion: The explanation of age correction is technically cautious enough that Nikolai would not apply the ten-decibel shortcut before checking the separate recordability conditions.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the prose prevents the specific misunderstanding created by the situation.

criteria.description: 该指南将基线定义为与后续阈值进行比较的听力图。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅仅提及基线而没有其比较功能是不够的。

original.criterion: The guide defines the baseline as the audiogram against which later thresholds are compared.
original.grader_hint: A mere mention of baseline without its comparison function is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该指南解释说，在计算班次之前，必须验证基线的正确工人、耳朵、日期和适用的先前听力图。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找足够的特异性，以防止与错误的先前测试进行比较。

original.criterion: The guide explains that the baseline must be verified for the correct worker, ear, date, and applicable prior audiogram before calculating a shift.
original.grader_hint: Look for enough specificity to prevent comparison against the wrong prior test.

criteria.description: 该指南解释说，修订基线不仅仅是为了使转变消失，并且仅在管理要求允许的情况下描述了修订。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件应将修订与已确认的、永久的 STS 或其他允许的基础联系起来，并禁止便利修订。

original.criterion: The guide explains that a baseline is not revised merely to make a shift disappear and describes revision only in the circumstances allowed by the governing requirements.
original.grader_hint: The document should link revision to a confirmed, permanent STS or another permitted basis and prohibit convenience revision.

criteria.description: 该指南指出，雇主可以在初次听力图后30天内重新进行测试。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求数量30和单位天数。

original.criterion: The guide states that the employer may retest within 30 days of the initial audiogram.
original.grader_hint: Require the number 30 and the unit days.

criteria.description: 该指南解释了重新测试结果如何影响最终决定：雇主在重新测试确认轮班时使用重新测试，并且在不考虑允许的窗口的情况下不会将初始结果视为最终结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查重新测试是否被描述为确认途径，而不是自动擦除或自动确认。

original.criterion: The guide explains how the retest result affects the final determination: the employer uses the retest when the retest confirms the shift, and does not treat the initial result as final without considering the permitted window.
original.grader_hint: Check that the retest is described as a confirmation pathway rather than an automatic eraser or automatic confirmation.

criteria.description: 该指南识别了工作相关性，并将其与简单地观察听力图上的变化区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 可记录性或因果关系讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须告诉读者，观察到的阈值变化本身并不能建立工作相关性。

original.criterion: The guide identifies work-relatedness and distinguishes it from simply observing a change on an audiogram.
original.grader_hint: The reader must be told that an observed threshold change does not by itself establish work-relatedness.

criteria.description: 该指南解释说，该病例必须是永久性的，或者在适用的评估过程中不会返回基线，然后才能被视为可记录的听力损失病例。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受谨慎的等效措辞，但不要声称每个临时轮班都是可记录的。

original.criterion: The guide explains that the case must be permanent, or not return to baseline within the applicable assessment process, before it is treated as a recordable hearing-loss case.
original.grader_hint: Accept careful equivalent wording, but not a claim that every temporary shift is recordable.

criteria.description: 该指南指出，合格的可记录案例应在案例确定后七个日历日内输入 OSHA 表格300 日志中。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要表格/日志参考和七个日历日的截止日期。

original.criterion: The guide states that a qualifying recordable case is entered on the OSHA Form 300 log within seven calendar days after the case is determined.
original.grader_hint: Require both the form/log reference and the seven-calendar-day deadline.

criteria.description: 该指南规定，必须在 STS 确定后21天内以书面形式通知员工。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查书面通知和21天期限。

original.criterion: The guide states that the employee must be notified in writing within 21 days after the STS is determined.
original.grader_hint: Check for written notification and the 21-day period.

criteria.description: 该指南解释说，必须告知接受 STS 的员工结果以及听力保护或听力保存后续行动的必要性（如适用）。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求员工沟通以及实际保护/计划后续行动，而不仅仅是记录保存。

original.criterion: The guide explains that an employee with an STS must be informed of the result and of the need for hearing-protection or hearing-conservation follow-up as applicable.
original.grader_hint: Look for employee communication plus practical protection/program follow-up, not recordkeeping alone.

criteria.description: 该指南指出，必须根据听力保护要求提供并提供听力保护器，并且其适合和使用很重要。
criteria.grader_hint: 该措辞不应减少仅仅交出耳塞的义务。

original.criterion: The guide states that hearing protectors must be provided and made available when required by the hearing-conservation requirements, and that fit and use matter.
original.grader_hint: The wording should not reduce the duty to merely handing over earplugs.

criteria.description: 该指南将 85 dBA 8 小时时间加权平均暴露水平确定为与纳入听力保护计划相关的阈值。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要 dBA、8 小时时间加权平均值和85 值。

original.criterion: The guide identifies the 85 dBA 8-hour time-weighted-average exposure level as the threshold associated with inclusion in a hearing conservation program.
original.grader_hint: Require dBA, an 8-hour time-weighted average, and the 85 value.

criteria.description: 该指南明确区分了听力图分类、OSHA 记录保存和听力保护随访，因此不会以一种结果自动决定所有三项结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断人力资源读者是否可以独立拨打每种类型的电话而不会将它们混为一谈。

original.criterion: The guide clearly separates audiogram classification, OSHA recordkeeping, and hearing-conservation follow-up so that one outcome is not presented as automatically deciding all three.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether an HR reader could independently make each type of call without conflating them.

criteria.description: 该指南提供了一个紧凑的决策序列或检查表，首先在应用阈值之前验证工作人员、耳朵、基线和听力图质量。
criteria.grader_hint: 该序列必须包括数字分类之前的验证。

original.criterion: The guide provides a compact decision sequence or checklist that starts with verifying the worker, ear, baseline, and audiogram quality before applying the thresholds.
original.grader_hint: The sequence must include verification before numerical classification.

criteria.description: 该指南指出了可能使听力图比较无效或扭曲的情况，例如安静不足、测试条件差或临时传导问题，并指示读者不要将此类结果视为未经审查就已解决。
criteria.grader_hint: 奖励至少两个具体例子和明确的结果。

original.criterion: The guide identifies conditions that can invalidate or distort an audiogram comparison, such as inadequate quiet, poor test conditions, or a temporary conductive issue, and directs the reader not to treat such a result as settled without review.
original.grader_hint: Award for at least two concrete examples and a clear consequence.

criteria.description: 该指南告诉读者何时需要进行临床或听力随访，而无需根据阈值数据诊断员工。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找转诊或专业审查触发因素以及明确的非诊断边界。

original.criterion: The guide tells the reader when clinical or audiologic follow-up is warranted, without diagnosing the employee from the threshold data.
original.grader_hint: Look for referral or professional-review triggers and an explicit non-diagnosis boundary.

criteria.description: 该指南指出，雇主应根据 OSHA 记录保留要求保留听力记录和支持文件，包括员工病历的30年期限（如适用）。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求保留义务和30年期限或与医疗记录相关的准确等效期限。

original.criterion: The guide states that the employer should retain the audiometric records and supporting documentation in accordance with OSHA record-retention requirements, including the 30-year period for employee medical records where applicable.
original.grader_hint: Require both retention duty and the 30-year period or an accurate equivalent tied to medical records.

criteria.description: 该指南使用简单的语言，定义了不可避免的技术术语，可供从未处理过听证会案件的人力资源总监使用。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断清晰度、易读性以及行话是否经过翻译而不仅仅是缩写。

original.criterion: The guide uses plain language, defines unavoidable technical terms, and is usable by an HR director who has never handled a hearing case.
original.grader_hint: Judge clarity, scannability, and whether jargon is translated rather than merely abbreviated.

criteria.description: 该指南明确标记了哪些陈述是法律要求，哪些是决策警告，哪些需要职业健康或听力学审查。
criteria.evidence: 标签、标注或精确的限定语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 当文件防止实际警告被误认为 OSHA 规则时授予奖励。

original.criterion: The guide explicitly marks which statements are legal requirements, which are decision cautions, and which require occupational-health or audiology review.
original.evidence: Labels, callouts, or precise qualifying language.
original.grader_hint: Award when the document prevents a practical caution from being mistaken for an OSHA rule.

criteria.description: 该指南不要求特定于工人的可记录性结果、诊断或无法根据所提供的事实确定的应得福利。
criteria.evidence: 关于十四班倒和歧义案件的陈述。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查例子和结论；一般说明性示例必须明确标记，并且不得归因于实际工人。

original.criterion: The guide does not claim worker-specific recordability results, diagnoses, or owed benefits that cannot be determined from the supplied facts.
original.evidence: Statements about the fourteen shifts and ambiguous cases.
original.grader_hint: Inspect examples and conclusion; generic illustrative examples must be clearly labeled and must not be attributed to actual workers.

criteria.description: 该指南不使用员工姓名、医疗标识符、地址或不必要的个人听力图值，从而最大限度地减少敏感信息。
criteria.evidence: 完整的文档文本和渲染的页面。
criteria.grader_hint: 虚构的案例标签是可以接受的；不需要识别细节来解释规则。

original.criterion: The guide minimizes sensitive information by using no employee names, medical identifiers, addresses, or unnecessary individual audiogram values.
original.evidence: Full document text and rendered pages.
original.grader_hint: Fictional case labels are acceptable; do not require identifying details to explain the rule.

criteria.description: DOCX 和 PDF 就每个共享数值达成一致，包括10 dB、25 dB、30 天、7 日历天、21 天、85 dBA、8 小时和 30 年（如有说明）。
criteria.evidence: 提取文本比较和视觉审查。
criteria.grader_hint: 规范化空白并比较两个文件中的实质性文本和数字。

original.criterion: The DOCX and PDF agree on every shared numeric value, including 10 dB, 25 dB, 30 days, 7 calendar days, 21 days, 85 dBA, 8 hours, and 30 years where stated.
original.evidence: Extracted text comparison and visual review.
original.grader_hint: Normalize whitespace and compare the substantive text and numbers across both files.

criteria.description: DOCX和PDF包含相同的决策逻辑、定义、注意事项和雇主义务，不存在因转换而造成的重大遗漏。
criteria.grader_hint: 美观的分页或换行差异是可以接受的；丢失或更改的内容则不然。

original.criterion: The DOCX and PDF contain the same decision logic, definitions, cautions, and employer duties, with no material omission caused by conversion.
original.grader_hint: A cosmetic pagination or line-break difference is acceptable; missing or changed content is not.

criteria.description: 该指南以明确的分类和职责摘要结束，而不是含糊地邀请采取后续步骤，同时仍将未解决的案例引导至适当的职业健康审查。
criteria.grader_hint: 结局应该给尼古拉一个可用的终点和升级边界，而不是关于记录哪些个案的建议。

original.criterion: The guide ends with a clear classification-and-duty summary rather than a vague invitation to take next steps, while still directing unresolved cases to appropriate occupational-health review.
original.grader_hint: The ending should give Nikolai a usable endpoint and escalation boundary, not a recommendation about which individual cases to record.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

spec.professional_context: This is an occupational-health communication package for an enterprise food-manufacturing employer. The reader is an HR director who needs accurate, self-contained explanations of recordability and follow-up duties, not a clinical diagnosis or a recommendation about individual employees.
difficulty_sources: Distinguishing standard threshold shift from an OSHA-recordable hearing-loss case
Applying age correction, baseline comparison, and the 30-day retest window without collapsing them into one shortcut
Explaining employer duties in plain language for a non-clinical executive
Keeping a DOCX and PDF version numerically and substantively aligned

authoring_plan.purpose: Construct an offline gold package consisting of a two-page plain-language hearing-threshold-shift guide in DOCX and an equivalent PDF. The files should be authored from federal OSHA occupational knowledge current through December 31, 2024, not from supplied reference files.
content_constraints: Use a short executive-facing explanation followed by a compact decision aid.
Keep STS, recordability, work-relatedness, permanence, retesting, and hearing-conservation duties visibly distinct.

Include the exact professional thresholds and periods scored in the rubric: 10 dB average at 2/3/4 kHz, 25 dB above audiometric zero, 30-day retest, 7-calendar-day log deadline, 21-day written notice, 85 dBA 8-hour TWA, and 30-year medical-record retention where applicable.
Explain age correction as a limited recordability consideration, not a universal subtraction and not a replacement for the STS calculation.
Explain baseline verification and permitted revision cautiously; prohibit changing a baseline simply to remove an inconvenient shift.
Include audiogram-quality and temporary-condition cautions, plus a clear boundary against diagnosing or deciding unprovided worker-specific cases.
Use generic fictional labels such as Case A and Case B only if examples are needed; do not create actual employee results.
Minimize sensitive content and avoid employee names, identifiers, or unnecessary audiometric data.

gold_derivation.definitions: Build a terminology block defining baseline, STS, recordable hearing-loss case, age correction, permanence, and work-relatedness.
gold_derivation.decision_logic: Derive the flow from record verification and test quality through frequency-specific average, STS determination, 25 dB criterion, age correction where permitted, work-relatedness/permanence review, and final recordkeeping decision.
gold_derivation.follow_up: Derive a separate duty block covering written employee notification within 21 days, OSHA 300-log entry within 7 calendar days after determination, hearing protection and conservation-program implications, exposure review at 85 dBA 8-hour TWA, and professional follow-up.
gold_derivation.ambiguity_handling: Include two clearly labeled generic ambiguous examples: one where the 10 dB shift does not satisfy the additional recordability condition, and one where retesting or quality review prevents an immediate final classification. Do not assign either example to the fourteen actual workers.
gold_derivation.cross_file_validation: Generate the PDF from the finalized DOCX or compare extracted text after conversion; verify that every shared number, definition, and duty remains identical.

review_checks: Render both files and confirm no more than two pages.
Check that all rubric thresholds and deadlines are present and accurately qualified.
Check that no claim says every STS is recordable or that age correction automatically removes a case.
Check that the final summary is actionable for classification and escalation but contains no worker-specific verdict.
Check DOCX/PDF substantive equivalence and absence of sensitive identifiers.

deliverables.description: A plain-language, audience-specific guide for the HR director explaining OSHA hearing threshold-shift recordability and employer follow-up duties.
constraints: Must be no more than two pages when rendered.
Must use fictional case identifiers only and omit employee names and direct identifiers.
Must state federal OSHA requirements current on December 31, 2024.
Must not invent results for the fourteen workers or claim that any particular worker is recordable without supplied audiogram data.
Must agree with the PDF on every shared definition, threshold, time period, and figure.

deliverables.description: The circulation-ready PDF version of the same plain-language guide.
constraints: Must be no more than two pages when rendered.
Must be substantively and numerically identical to the DOCX.
Must use fictional case identifiers only and omit employee names and direct identifiers.
Must remain readable for an executive who has not handled a hearing case before.

original_instruction:
You are Camila Bonneau, occupational health nurse supporting Ballantry Foundry, and Nikolai Ingram needs this before Friday’s review of the fourteen standard threshold shifts reported from the deboning lines. He has never handled a hearing case, and people are using “standard threshold shift” to mean both a clinical change and an OSHA-recordable case. A second problem is that the usual “ten-decibel loss means recordable” shortcut is being repeated even though age correction, the baseline, and two ambiguous cases make it unsafe here. Prepare a plain-language guide for Nikolai, using federal OSHA requirements current on December 31, 2024, so he can classify cases and understand the employer’s required follow-up without asking you what each term means. Cover the decision points, the 30-day retest window, age correction, baseline revision, recordkeeping, worker notification, hearing protection, and when exposure or medical follow-up matters; distinguish requirements from practical cautions and do not invent worker-specific results that were not provided. Keep it to two pages, avoid clinical diagnosis and names or identifiers, and make the same figures and definitions appear in both `hearing_threshold_shift_guide.docx` and `hearing_threshold_shift_guide.pdf`. Write both files into the top level of the working directory, using exactly those filenames. Sheafield Systems will circulate the PDF, while HR will retain the editable Word file.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `hearing_threshold_shift_guide.docx` — A plain-language, audience-specific guide for the HR director explaining OSHA hearing threshold-shift recordability and employer follow-up duties. (Must be no more than two pages when rendered.; Must use fictional case identifiers only and omit employee names and direct identifiers.; Must state federal OSHA requirements current on December 31, 2024.; Must not invent results for the fourteen workers or claim that any particular worker is recordable without supplied audiogram data.; Must agree with the PDF on every shared definition, threshold, time period, and figure.)
- `hearing_threshold_shift_guide.pdf` — The circulation-ready PDF version of the same plain-language guide. (Must be no more than two pages when rendered.; Must be substantively and numerically identical to the DOCX.; Must use fictional case identifiers only and omit employee names and direct identifiers.; Must remain readable for an executive who has not handled a hearing case before.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
